presets.name: Snap pick
presets.desc: Lifts the pick click on every note by 8 dB on the highs only; the low strings' fundamentals stay put
presets.notes: A shelf at 1.5 kHz carries the boost: the pick gets louder, the bass of a low E is not pumped

presets.name: Soft pick
presets.desc: Takes 9 dB off each pick attack and lets the note through untouched: a rounder, jazzier touch
presets.notes: Zero latency lets a short tick through at each pick; lookahead 2 ms removes it where latency is acceptable

presets.name: Funk pop
presets.desc: Sharper 16th strums: attacks up 10 dB, muted chops pulled down 8 dB, ringing chords left alone
presets.notes: sus_time 250 ms: chops decay faster than the reference and are cut, sustained chords are not. sc_hpf 120 is safe down to a low B

presets.name: Chug tight
presets.desc: Palm-mute definition into a high-gain amp: each chug's attack up 6 dB, its tail cut 10 dB
presets.notes: Placed before the amp. Drop A: sc_hpf 100 (at or under twice the lowest note). Complements a gate

presets.name: Pick definition after the amp
presets.desc: Restores the pick attack an amp compressed, detecting on the clean DI; peaks held under -1 dBFS
presets.notes: The key input carries the DI: a high-gain signal has few level changes left, its DI has them all

presets.name: Ring out
presets.desc: Clean arpeggios ring longer: tails lifted up to 10 dB, never above their height over the noise floor
presets.notes: A 2 s reference shapes slowly decaying notes; thresh just above the rig's hiss keeps the noise from being lifted

presets.name: Bass click
presets.desc: The bass's finger or pick click up 8 dB on the highs; the fundamental is not modulated
presets.notes: A full-band attack on a low E would reshape its first cycle; the shelf moves the boost to the click

presets.name: Bass thump
presets.desc: More knock on each bass note: the lows boosted 6 dB over two full periods of a low E
presets.notes: att_time 60 ms covers whole cycles of a 41 Hz note, so the boost is a thump, not one louder half-cycle

presets.name: Bass even
presets.desc: Fingerstyle evenness without a threshold: plucks softened 6 dB, held notes lifted up to 6 dB
presets.notes: Acts the same at any playing level: a compressor-like evenness with no threshold to set

presets.name: Drum punch
presets.desc: Drum bus punch: hits up 9 dB, tails tightened 4 dB, the boosted peaks soft-clipped under 0 dBFS
presets.notes: sc_hpf 120 shortens the detector's hold to 20 ms. Accents get more than ghost notes

presets.name: Gated snare
presets.desc: Cuts a snare's tail by up to 24 dB at any hit strength, half of it 60 ms after the hit
presets.notes: A tail shaper, not a gate: no threshold to set. For a hard gate, use the gate block

presets.name: Room dry
presets.desc: Pulls a live voice's room down 8 dB after each phrase, leaves held notes alone, at any singing level
presets.notes: A short reference (58 dB / s): only the room's fall after a phrase is faster than it

presets.name: Consonants
presets.desc: Clearer diction: the consonants' attacks up 5 dB on the highs
presets.notes: Pair it with a de-esser placed after

presets.name: Acoustic body
presets.desc: Less pick and more body on an acoustic guitar: attacks down 4 dB, tails up 6 dB
presets.notes: sus_time 800 ms lifts the ring of strummed chords without touching the pick

presets.name: Studio clean punch
presets.desc: Drum punch with the gain in place before each hit and no peak over 0 dBFS (1 ms latency)
presets.notes: Lookahead 1 ms ramps the gain in before the transient: the first cycle is boosted whole. Not for a song that switches lookahead live
